name: OpenClaw Widget Bridge
description: Minimal, privacy-safe widget summary API for health and usage data

apiToken.description: Bearer token for authenticating widget requests

cliPath.description: Path to the openclaw CLI binary

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for CLI commands in milliseconds

usageDays.description: Default number of days for usage queries

cacheTtlSeconds.description: Cache TTL in seconds for health and usage data

openclawHome.description: OpenClaw home directory path (default: ~/.openclaw). Precedence: this value > OPENCLAW_HOME env > ~/.openclaw
